title: Growth Trellis personal sprint notes
content:
Growth Trellis — personal sprint notes (working doc)

Context
- Sprint: personal 2-week focus (2026-02-16 → 2026-03-01). Aligning people-ops goals to platform/product priorities and preparing for upcoming 1:1 with manager.
- Objective: consolidate evidence and articulate asks (headcount, comp, stretch project), and capture quick stories for manager time (10–15 min).

Top outcome goals (3)
1) Improve new-hire time-to-product for Eng ICs (target: reduce from 42 -> 30 days by end of Q2). Signal: onboarding survey NPS + time to first PR merged.
2) Ship onboarding playbook M2 (deliverables: role-specific checklists + 2-week mentor cadence) by mid-April. Signal: mentor adoption rate >= 70% in pilot cohort.
3) Create a hiring funnel dashboard for hiring managers with weekly alerts (target: reduce stale reqs by 40%).

Progress / shipped since last check-in
- Candidate experience micro-changes rolled to offer flow (JIRA: PLAT-842). Early A/B shows 8% increase in accepted counter-offers.
- Draft PR for onboarding templates: github.com/redwood-inference/people-ops/pull/314 — waiting review from Elena.
- Ran pilot mentor pairing for 8 new hires; collected qualitative notes (Slack thread #onboarding-feedback).

Impact evidence (what to surface)
- Hiring: offer acceptance rate up 3% month-over-month in Feb (source: hiring-sheet Feb tabs). Recruiter time per hire down ~6 hours due to form changes.
- Onboarding: Pilot cohort reported mean confidence score on core tasks = 3.8/5 (qualitative notes attached in Confluence ONB-2026).
- Cost: quicker time-to-product implies reduced ramp cost (estimate: ~$12k saved per IC for a 12-day improvement).

Stories to tell (30–90s)
- Story A (candidate experience): "We fixed the offer confusion clause — one candidate explicitly said the clearer language made them accept over a competing offer."
- Story B (onboarding mentor): "Mentor pairing surfacing one early blocker saved an engineer two days of rework — highlights mentorship ROI."

Manager conversation prompts (explicit asks)
- Headcount: request permission to reopen 1 IC requisition for onboarding ops (justify with funnel metrics + revenue impact).
- Comp: surface comp benchmark discrepancy for Senior Recruiter (request exploratory calibration conversation).
- Stretch: ask to lead cross-functional onboarding revamp (30% capacity for next 6 weeks).
- Support: ask for OK to spend $3k on external onboarding tool pilot (pilot will be A/B against current workflow).

Open questions / blockers
- Data access: need read access to the new hiring analytics dataset (data-warehouse team). Ticket created but blocked (ENGOPS-1199).
- Review lag: PR review waiting on Elena and Legal for template language. Follow-up ping scheduled.
- Prioritization: bandwidth tensions with quarterly launch timelines—need manager alignment on tradeoffs.

Next actions (this week)
- Extract two charts for 1:1: time-to-offer trend + stale-reqs by team (ask Data for CSV).
- Prepare 3-slide appendix for manager: problem, evidence, ask (<= 5 min walk-through).
- Draft comp rationale: market comps + internal leveling examples.
- Ping Elena on PR and schedule 15m async review.

Quick wins to mention in 1:1
- Small copy change to offer email increased accept rate in pilot cohort.
- Mentor pairing reduced first-week blockers in 6/8 hires.

Evidence to attach before 1:1
- hiring-sheet Feb (spreadsheet) — key tabs: offer-flow A/B, recruiter-time logs.
- Confluence: ONB-2026 (pilot feedback + templates).
- Slack thread: #onboarding-feedback (anonymized quotes).

Notes to self (tone + framing)
- Be concise: Top-line metric + immediate ask first. Follow with 2 supporting anecdotes and 1 risk.
- Use manager's language: talk about "time-to-product" and "reduced ramp cost".
- If pushed on capacity: propose 3-month pilot and measurable success criteria.

Misc scratch (brain dump)
- If promotion is on table later this year: build a 6-month roadmap (impact vector + leadership examples).
- Consider running a cross-functional retro after pilot to capture lessons.
- Possible ally: Elena (product partner), Raj (data), Sam (eng manager champion).

End of doc — keep as living log.
